evals.name: go-new-setup
evals.prompt: Apply my limitping-style Nix setup to this Go CLI: adapt .editorconfig, .envrc, and justfile; use flake-parts partitions to separate packages from dev checks, git-hooks, and treefmt. Preserve the custom recipe and HELLO_MODE environment setup, update usage documentation, and leave the second application unchanged. There is no CI configuration.
evals.expected_output: Working Go package and dev checks using separate input flake/locks, adapted companion files, existing custom recipe and environment retained, no licensing changes, repeat application produces no changes.
assertions: The package derivation evaluates and builds with the target executable.
Package evaluation succeeds without the development input directory.
Development outputs include formatting, hook, and Go test/static-analysis checks.
Original custom recipe and HELLO_MODE environment setting remain usable.
Go indentation is tabs; companion files follow the requested setup.
No licensing or application behavior changes are introduced.

evals.name: rust-existing-setup
evals.prompt: Migrate this Rust project's existing Nix setup to the limitping-style flake-parts partitions, treefmt-nix, and git-hooks/prek structure. Preserve the named hello-rust package, custom recipe, HELLO_MODE, Makefile tabs, and Markdown whitespace exception. Keep the handwritten treefmt.toml and its behavior. Introduce no Go tools or licensing changes. A second application should make no changes.
evals.expected_output: Existing Rust package preserved, development outputs routed to separate partition, Rust formatting/test checks, original regular config retained or explicitly reconciled, indentation exceptions retained, idempotent adaptation.
assertions: The original named Rust package remains available and evaluates.
Package evaluation succeeds without the development input directory.
Development outputs include formatting, hook, and Rust project test checks.
The regular treefmt.toml retains its original contents.
Custom recipe, HELLO_MODE, Makefile tabs, and Markdown whitespace exception are retained.
No Go tooling, licensing changes, or application behavior changes are introduced.
